extracted.name: Easy French Onion Soup Dip
extracted.description: Throw back from the 80's! This French Onion Dip is the ONLY recipe I make using a store bought packet mix. I can't let it go - it brings me right back to my childhood!
ingredient_lines: 400 g / 14 oz sour cream ((full fat is better))
½ cup mayonnaise ((Mayo labelled “whole egg” mayo is best))
40 g / 1.4 oz French Onion Soup Mix (store bought) (, salt reduced is best)
instruction_lines: Mix ingredients together in a bowl. Rest for 5 minutes or until onion bits in the soup mix become softened.
